cc:Work.dc:title: reconstruction-signal-range
cc:Work.dc:description: Earlier SF7 receptions from May 2026 with fresh GPS and receiver locations. Eleven of 49 have signal-to-noise ratio at or below the June contact's -7.25 dB, at slant ranges from 22.4 to 251.6 km. Each point is a gateway reception, not an independent packet.
